title: Bikeopolis
seoDescription: An end-to-end shopping experience for urban cyclists, from discovery and configuration through checkout.
deck: An end-to-end shopping experience for urban cyclists, from discovery and configuration through checkout.

blocks.heading: A clearer route from discovering a bike to owning it.
blocks.left: Urban cyclists needed enough product detail to choose confidently without navigating a catalogue built for experts.
blocks.right: The experience connected discovery, comparison, configuration, and checkout in one approachable purchase journey.

blocks.quote: The complete process, screens, and outcomes will be added through the CMS.
